content.json:
# Claude team governance

Team-level usage, developer spend, model cost, and governance health for traffic routed through the Claude gateway. Team attribution comes from `x-caller-team-id`; developer attribution comes from `x-caller-oid` / `x-caller-upn`.

**Cost coverage:** estimated costs use `PRICING_CL` with APIM prompt and completion tokens. They exclude cache reads and writes, so they can be lower than the budget-enforcement counter. Requests made before team headers were deployed remain visible as unattributed but cannot be assigned retroactively.

parameters.name: Team
parameters.label: Team
parameters.query:
union (print value="*", label="All teams"), (ClaudeTeams() | project value=TeamId, label=TeamDisplayName)
| order by label asc

content.query:
let rates = PRICING_CL
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Model
| project Model, InPer1K=InputTokensPrice, OutPer1K=OutputTokensPrice;
let gw = ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where TimeGenerated >= startofmonth(now())
| where Url has "/anthropic"
| extend TeamId=tostring(coalesce(BackendRequestHeaders["x-caller-team-id"], ResponseHeaders["x-caller-team-id"])), TeamState=tostring(coalesce(BackendRequestHeaders["x-team-governance-state"], ResponseHeaders["x-team-governance-state"]));
let llm = ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog
| where TimeGenerated >= startofmonth(now()) and isnotempty(RequestId)
| extend Model=iff(isempty(ModelName), "unknown", replace_regex(ModelName, @"-\d{8}$", ""));
let spend = gw
| join kind=inner llm on CorrelationId
| lookup kind=leftouter rates on Model
| extend EstimatedCostUsd=(PromptTokens * coalesce(InPer1K, 0.0) + CompletionTokens * coalesce(OutPer1K, 0.0)) / 1000.0
| where isnotempty(TeamId) and TeamState == "ok"
| summarize MtdEstimatedCostUsd=round(sum(EstimatedCostUsd), 2) by TeamId;
ClaudeTeams()
| where TeamId == "{Team}" or "{Team}" == "*"
| join kind=leftouter spend on TeamId
| extend MtdEstimatedCostUsd=coalesce(MtdEstimatedCostUsd, 0.0), UtilizationPct=round(100.0 * coalesce(MtdEstimatedCostUsd, 0.0) / CostQuota, 1)
| project TeamId, TeamDisplayName, Profile, DefaultUserTier, CostQuotaUsd=CostQuota, MtdEstimatedCostUsd, UtilizationPct
| order by UtilizationPct desc
content.title: Team monthly-to-date estimated spend vs. cost quota
content.description: Estimated APIM inference cost excludes cache reads and writes; enforcement counters can be higher.

content.json:
## Developer cost within each team

Primary chargeback view. Select one team above to isolate its members, or leave **All teams** selected for comparison.

content.query:
let rates = PRICING_CL
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Model
| project Model, InPer1K=InputTokensPrice, OutPer1K=OutputTokensPrice;
let gwBase = ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Url has "/anthropic"
| extend Oid=tostring(coalesce(BackendRequestHeaders["x-caller-oid"], ResponseHeaders["x-caller-oid"])), RawUpn=tostring(coalesce(BackendRequestHeaders["x-caller-upn"], ResponseHeaders["x-caller-upn"])), TeamId=tostring(coalesce(BackendRequestHeaders["x-caller-team-id"], ResponseHeaders["x-caller-team-id"])), TeamState=tostring(coalesce(BackendRequestHeaders["x-team-governance-state"], ResponseHeaders["x-team-governance-state"]));
let ids = gwBase | where isnotempty(RawUpn) | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, RawUpn) by Oid | project Oid, KnownUpn=RawUpn;
let gw = gwBase
| join kind=leftouter ids on Oid
| extend Developer=case(isnotempty(RawUpn), RawUpn, isnotempty(KnownUpn), KnownUpn, isnotempty(Oid), Oid, "anonymous")
| project CorrelationId, TimeGenerated, TeamId, TeamState, Developer, Oid;
let llm = ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and isnotempty(RequestId)
| extend Model=iff(isempty(ModelName), "unknown", replace_regex(ModelName, @"-\d{8}$", ""));
gw
| join kind=inner llm on CorrelationId
| lookup kind=leftouter rates on Model
| extend EstimatedCostUsd=(PromptTokens * coalesce(InPer1K, 0.0) + CompletionTokens * coalesce(OutPer1K, 0.0)) / 1000.0
| where isnotempty(TeamId) and TeamState == "ok"
| where TeamId == "{Team}" or "{Team}" == "*"
| lookup kind=leftouter (ClaudeTeams() | project TeamId, TeamDisplayName) on TeamId
| summarize Requests=count(), PromptTokens=sum(PromptTokens), CompletionTokens=sum(CompletionTokens), TotalTokens=sum(TotalTokens), EstimatedCostUsd=round(sum(EstimatedCostUsd), 2), Models=make_set(Model, 10), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by TeamId, TeamDisplayName, Developer, Oid
| extend Models=strcat_array(array_sort_asc(Models), ", ")
| order by EstimatedCostUsd desc
content.title: Estimated cost per developer, segregated by team

content.json:
## Model usage and cost by team

Models are normalized by removing dated deployment suffixes. Rates come from the latest `PRICING_CL` record per model.

content.query:
let rates = PRICING_CL
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Model
| project Model, InPer1K=InputTokensPrice, OutPer1K=OutputTokensPrice;
let gw = ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Url has "/anthropic"
| extend TeamId=tostring(coalesce(BackendRequestHeaders["x-caller-team-id"], ResponseHeaders["x-caller-team-id"])), TeamState=tostring(coalesce(BackendRequestHeaders["x-team-governance-state"], ResponseHeaders["x-team-governance-state"]));
let llm = ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and isnotempty(RequestId)
| extend Model=iff(isempty(ModelName), "unknown", replace_regex(ModelName, @"-\d{8}$", ""));
gw
| join kind=inner llm on CorrelationId
| lookup kind=leftouter rates on Model
| extend EstimatedCostUsd=(PromptTokens * coalesce(InPer1K, 0.0) + CompletionTokens * coalesce(OutPer1K, 0.0)) / 1000.0

content.json:
## Health and governance

Check attribution coverage first: costs cannot be assigned when team identity is absent or ambiguous.

content.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Url has "/anthropic"
| extend TeamId=tostring(coalesce(BackendRequestHeaders["x-caller-team-id"], ResponseHeaders["x-caller-team-id"])), TeamState=tostring(coalesce(BackendRequestHeaders["x-team-governance-state"], ResponseHeaders["x-team-governance-state"]))
| extend Attribution=case(TeamState == "ok" and isnotempty(TeamId), "Attributed", isnotempty(TeamState), TeamState, "No team telemetry")
| summarize Requests=count(), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by Attribution
| order by Requests desc
content.title: Team attribution coverage

content.query:
AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Message startswith "TEAM_GOVERNANCE_EVENT"
| extend Evt = parse_json(substring(Message, strlen("TEAM_GOVERNANCE_EVENT ")))
| where tostring(Evt.type) == "ambiguous_identity"
| extend Oid = tostring(Evt.oid), State = tostring(Evt.state), TeamRoleCount = toint(Evt.teamRoleCount), ProfileRoleCount = toint(Evt.profileRoleCount)
| summarize Occurrences = count(), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by Oid, State, TeamRoleCount, ProfileRoleCount
| order by Occurrences desc
content.title: Ambiguous or missing team identity (reconcile before promoting to enforce)

content.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Url has "/anthropic"
| extend TeamId=tostring(coalesce(BackendRequestHeaders["x-caller-team-id"], ResponseHeaders["x-caller-team-id"])), DeniedBy=tostring(ResponseHeaders["x-claude-denied-by"])
| where isnotempty(DeniedBy)
| where TeamId == "{Team}" or "{Team}" == "*" or isempty(TeamId)
| lookup kind=leftouter (ClaudeTeams() | project TeamId, TeamDisplayName) on TeamId
| extend Team=case(isnotempty(TeamDisplayName), TeamDisplayName, isnotempty(TeamId), TeamId, "Unattributed")
| summarize Denials=count() by Team, DeniedBy, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| render columnchart
content.title: Denials by scope (user-budget / team-budget / identity / admin)

content.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Url has "/anthropic"
| extend TeamId = tostring(coalesce(BackendRequestHeaders["x-caller-team-id"], ResponseHeaders["x-caller-team-id"])),
         Oid = tostring(coalesce(BackendRequestHeaders["x-caller-oid"], ResponseHeaders["x-caller-oid"])),
         Upn = tostring(coalesce(BackendRequestHeaders["x-caller-upn"], ResponseHeaders["x-caller-upn"])),
         State = tostring(coalesce(BackendRequestHeaders["x-team-governance-state"], ResponseHeaders["x-team-governance-state"]))
| where isnotempty(TeamId) and TeamId != "none"
| summarize Requests = count(), Users = dcount(Oid) by TeamId, State
| join kind=leftouter (ClaudeTeams() | project TeamId, TeamDisplayName) on TeamId
| project TeamId, TeamDisplayName, State, Requests, Users
| order by Requests desc
content.title: Requests and distinct users per team (drill-down source)

content.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Url has "/anthropic"
| extend TeamId = tostring(coalesce(BackendRequestHeaders["x-caller-team-id"], ResponseHeaders["x-caller-team-id"])),
         Oid = tostring(coalesce(BackendRequestHeaders["x-caller-oid"], ResponseHeaders["x-caller-oid"])),
         Upn = tostring(coalesce(BackendRequestHeaders["x-caller-upn"], ResponseHeaders["x-caller-upn"]))
| where TeamId == "{Team}" or "{Team}" == "*"
| lookup kind=leftouter (ClaudeTeams() | project TeamId, TeamDisplayName) on TeamId
| summarize Requests = count(), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by TeamId, TeamDisplayName, Oid, Upn
| order by Requests desc
content.title: Members of selected team

content.query:
AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Message startswith "TEAM_GOVERNANCE_EVENT"
| extend Evt = parse_json(substring(Message, strlen("TEAM_GOVERNANCE_EVENT ")))
| where tostring(Evt.type) == "processor_lag"
| extend LagSeconds = todouble(Evt.lagSeconds)
| summarize AvgLagSeconds = avg(LagSeconds), MaxLagSeconds = max(LagSeconds) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| render timechart
content.title: Usage processor lag (Event Hub enqueue -> processed)

content.query:
ClaudeTeams()
| project TeamDisplayName, Profile
| summarize Teams = count() by Profile
| render piechart
content.title: Team distribution by profile
